Login hardening spec

Updated today at 9:23 AM

Stop credential stuffing without locking real people out.

Rules

  • Allow 5 failed attempts per account and IP address in 15 minutes.
  • Answer extra attempts with 429 and a Retry-After header.
  • Show people how long to wait.
  • Page on-call when failures pass 50 a minute.
